title: Rehydra Face Scrub- 75ml
description: Formulated with jojoba microspheres, bamboo powders and eco- sustainable Cuateteco, this hydrating facial scrub exfoliates and smoothes the skin. Radiant, revitalised skin.

title: Corrective Eye Complex- 15ml
description: DermaFix Corrective Eye Complex combines Apple Stem Cell Technology with powerful Peptides and Hyaluronic Acid. Our unique Corrective Eye Complex prevents free-radical attacks, which leads to a chemical change called cross-linking. The combination of Apple Stem Cells, Hyaluronic Acid and Rice Peptides, found in our Corrective Eye Complex, increases the longevity of skin cells, resulting in a reduction of lines and wrinkles.

title: Vitamin Therapy Masque- 125ml
description: The DermaFix Vitamin Therapy Masque is high in sterolins which are reputed to improve the appearance of age spots, sun damage and scarring. When used according to the supplied application guidelines, the Vitamin Therapy Masque offers super moisturisation and universal use.

title: Pumpkin Peptide Masque- 125ml
description: DermaFix Pumpkin Peptide Masque is an anti-oxidant rich, thermo masque assisting to remove redundant skin cells, offering re-texturising benefits whilst resurfacing the skin and encouraging cellular renewal. This masque is suited towards ageing, hyperpigmentation and breakout prone skin care concerns and leaves the skin glowing with a brighter and more radiant complexion.

title: HydroGel Collagen Masque Single
description: Hydrogel Masque is a once-off use masque that reinforces collagen and elastin within the skin, whilst helping to plump fine lines and wrinkles by offering superior hydration benefits. It refines the skin’s texture and assists to reduce inflammation, as a result calming skin irritation.

title: HydraSooth SOS- 125ml
description: HydraSooth SOS is a powerful anti-inflammatory corrective assisting to reduce skin sensitivity and inflammation. It comprises active ingredients working to boost the levels of hydration within the skin whilst promoting skin recovery and a refined texture.

title: Collagen Film Masque Single
description: With age the synthesis of collagen decreases, resulting in skin thinning with visible signs of ageing. Most components of the skin, including collagen, undergo continuous turnover. New collagen is continually produced and recycled throughout life. At a younger age the synthesis of collagen predominates, whereas after age 40 +, degradation of collagen becomes visible. For this reason it is recommended to make use of masques and the DermaFix Collagen Masque Film Masque will help soothe your skin to feel fresh and rejuvenated.

title: Calri-Fine Masque- 125ml
description: The DermaFix Clari-Fine Clay Masque is a neck and facial masque that has anti-inflammatory as well as anti-bacterial properties to give your skin a deep cleanse to remove impurities. The Clari-Fine Clay Masque is an enriched healing clay gel masque for deep cleansing of impurities and oil control. It is also an easy removal masque, so you don’t need to worry about getting it off. All you need to do is sit back and feel your skin get back to normal health.

title: Dermal Repair- 57ml
description: The DermaFix Dermal Repair serum is an exclusive multi-vitamin facial treatment. It contains an essential amount of Vitamin C, just the right concentration of Vitamin A and E, as well as beneficial minerals and extra pure essential oils. Dermal Repair maintains skin barrier integrity and prevents trans-epidermal water loss from environmental factors such as air-conditioning and sporting activities. Dermal Repair provides a smoothing, anti-oxidant, brightening and protective treatment for all types of environmentally damaged skin starting to show signs of ageing. When used prior to make-up, Dermal Repair will help to form a breathable moisture seal to achieve a smooth and even application for make-up.

title: ACC Vitamin C Gel- 57ml
description: This High Potency formula of Vitamin C, ACC Vitamin C, is a revolutionary anti-oxidant combination that delivers photo-protective capabilities, neutralising free-radicals, helping build collagen and providing unmatched anti-oxidant protection. More protection means more youthful looking skin and better defense against environmental ageing.

title: ACC Tranexamic Gel- 57ml
description: ACC Tranexamic Gel safely inhibits the growth of tyrosine and the activity level of melanin in problematic, hyperpigmentation skin concerns

title: ACC Retinol + 57ml
description: DermaFix ACC Retinol + incorporates ‘new science’ with the addition of its key ingredient Cylasphere® Retinol, an agar micro-sphere encapsulating retinol. The encapsulation of retinol allows for a slow release into the skin for improved bioavailability, efficacy and a gentler use. DermaFix ACC Retinol + stimulates the fibroblasts helping to thicken the dermis for firmer and younger-looking skin. This revolutionary serum, incorporating advanced Vitamin C, resurfaces the skin whilst offering superior skin revitalization

title: ACC Hyaluronic Gel- 57ml
description: ACC Hyaluronic Gel is a highly concentrated anti-ageing, moisture binding and skin repairing facial treatment. ACC Hyaluronic Gel slows down the ageing process, helping to re-plump and “fill in” wrinkles. ACC Hyaluronic Gel naturally occurs in dermal tissue and is a highly hydrophilic, gel-like substance in which the fibrous proteins collagen and elastin are embedded, thereby keeping them supple and flexible.

title: ACC Copper Peptide- 57ml
description: ACC Copper is an advanced formula which delivers a concentrate of Copper GHK-Cu3 and anti-oxidants to improve the signs of environmentally induced stressed skin. ACC Copper is an anti-inflammatory helping to reduce UV induced erythema (sunburn)

title: Vitamin C Serum- 30ml
description: This active Vitamin C Serum (hydra-stabilized L-Ascorbic Acid) helps to reduce the visible signs of photo-ageing by helping to fight destructive free radicals. In addition, when using the DermaFix Vitamin C Serum, the skin acquires important protection from damaging ultra-violet rays. These productive functions result in retextured, toned, and younger looking skin. The Vitamin-C Serum is made from organic citrus fruit concentrates that are rich in vitamin C and Amino Acids.

title: DermaLift + 157ml
description: The DermaFix DermaLift + Corrector is a deep penetrating dermal concentrate that corrects skin discolouration to give you a natural and healthy looking skin. The DermaLift + Corrector is a universal collagen and elastin moisturiser for stretch marks, neck and décolleté. It improves the length, depth and texture of stretch marks and restores firmness to the neck and décolleté by accelerating dermal healing. The inclusion of Vitamin A Propionate in the DermaLift + Corrector revitalises and balances the skin within 28 days of use.

title: Resveratrol + Corrective- 57ml
description: Unlock the power of advanced skincare with Resveratrol + Corrective, a multi-functional formula designed to support your skin’s microbiome while addressing various skin concerns. This powerhouse blend includes peptides, vitamins, essential fatty acids, and postbiotics to enhance your skin’s barrier function and resilience. Infused with Resveratrol, this treatment reduces photo-aging and minimizes keratinocyte inflammation, offering superior antioxidant protection. It also inhibits melanin synthesis, promoting a brighter, more even complexion.

title: LipFIX- 15ml
description: DermaFix LipFix is formulated with an active blend of Lip Perfecting and Plumping Technology. This formulation offers gradual lip plumping benefits whilst providing necessary skin hydration and protection.

title: Hyalu7 Boost- 15ml
description: DermaFix Hyalu7 Boost Hyaluronic Concentrate offers an advanced Hyaluronic acid formulation, incorporating an optimized ratio of 7 unique molecular weights to provide maximum hydration whilst stimulating hyaluronic acid production within the skin for deeper moisturisation and anti-ageing benefits. DermaFix Hyalu7 Boost works to improve skin firmness and elasticity whilst reducing water loss from the first application.

title: CircleLight- 15ml
description: DermaFix CircleLight is a dark circle corrector that contains anti-oxidants and peptides, working against ageing and environmental damage around the eye area. The DermaFix CircleLight skin corrective contains peptides that help prevent and fight bags under the eyes and increases peripheral circulation around the eye area.

title: Ceramide Eye Complex- 15ml
description: A revolutionary corrective, Ceramide Eye Complex, helps to lift up facial contours. Rich in DMAE to enhance the effects of the powerful blend of active ingredients. Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles and improves skin elasticity. Formulated with age-defying Ceramides, DMAE, Hyaluronic and Apple Stem Cells. Ceramide Eye Complex rejuvenates skin, instantaneously lifts and repairs the natural lipid barrier of the skin.

title: B3 Boost- 15ml
description: DermaFix B3 Boost Niacinamide Concentrate, also known as Vitamin B3 or Nicotinamide, that enhances the skin’s barrier and functioning by increasing the synthesis of ceramides and free fatty acids within the skin.

title: Tinted SPF40- 50ml
description: Experience the ultimate in sun protection with DermaFix Tinted SPF, a broad-spectrum sunscreen with SPF 40, SANS-approved UVA/UVB/HEV light defense. Beyond safeguarding your skin, this tinted formulation offers color corrective coverage, making it ideal for various skin tones from Fitzpatrick I to IV.

title: DermaShield SPF50- 125ml
description: DermaShield SPF50 sunscreen provides high UVA/UVB protection for all skin types. DermaShield SPF50 is a scientifically advanced sun protection product that is PABA & Fragrance-free and contains a proprietary blend of sunscreen ingredients which protects the skin from damaging UVA/UVB rays that are associated with sun related skin damage and premature ageing.

title: Vitaplex-C Cream- 57ml
description: MLVitaPlex-C, which is a multi-vitamin revitalizing moisturiser, promotes collagen synthesis with a high concentration of vitamins C, A, D, B5 and E. In addition, DermaFix Vitaplex-C moisturiser activate the skin’s native collagen and provides moisturising benefits through its natural herbal extracts, nourishing oils, and exclusive amino acids.

title: Vitamin B Cream- 57ml

Vitamin B cream consists of a combination of complex natural botanical extracts, vitamins, and amino acids help to moisturise and balance the skin, while natural Vitamin B Complex (Yeast Extract) helps to regulate oil gland secretion to reduce the possibility of clogged pores, inflammation and breakouts. D-Pathenol, found within the DermaFix Vitamin B Cream, stimulates skin healing whilst providing deep moisturisation needed to combat sensitive skin.

title: Skin ResQ- 125ml
description: Skin ResQ is the next generation of a weightless nourishing emollient blend with Murumuru Seed Butter and CoQ10. This superior formulation offers anti-oxidant protection keeping the skin moisturised, hydrated and supple for the prevention of stretch mark formation on the body. Formulated for universal use, Skin ResQ rapidly penetrates into the skin for all day protection, without the sensation of a greasy film.

title: Regenerate Rx EGF- 57ml
description: Regenerate RX is a highly effective complex containing epidermal growth factors, anti-oxidants, anti-inflammatory healing oils and protein stimulating glycosaminoglycans from plants. The DermaFix Regenerate RX anti-ageing corrective is specifically used for the prevention of blotchy skin, spider veins, scars, bruises, dry and ageing skin. It contains essential fatty acids and vitamins in a non-greasy formula that is absorbed immediately, leaving the skin protected, soft and supple

title: PowerDerm- 57ml
description: Intensive Anti-Ageing Stem Cell Complex, PowerDerm, protects and stimulates the mitochondria enhancing the ATP (energy) levels of the skin cells. When the PowerDerm anti-ageing corrective is applied then collagen synthesis is stimulated, combating chronological ageing. Plant Stem Cells are used in the PowerDerm product to Protect Skin Stem Cells.

title: DeCeLeRate- Peptides - 57ml
description: Peptide Rich Moisturiser For Age-Reversal Effects. This highly active DermaFix anti-ageing corrective product is suitable for all skin types with visible signs of ageing. DeCeLeRate contains actives that inhibit the SNARE complex formation and activate the natural process of tissue repair. These Peptides, found in DeCeLeRate, stimulate fibroblasts to synthesize Collagen and Elastin fibres.

title: Bio-Hydrating Cream- 57ml
description: The DermaFix Bio-Hydrating cream is a highly effective lightweight emollient, moisturising and rejuvenating cream. It is a great all-round moisturiser. Bio-Hydrating Cream is recommended for all types of non-problematic skin, and when applied correctly leaves your skin soft and glowing. Excellent results are achieved when used with the DermaFix skin care serums. Our Bio-Hydrating Cream contains only the finest natural moisturisers: Sodium PCA, and Hyaluronic Complex (Mucopolysaccharides), as well as Marine Collagen, Elastin, and Seaweed extracts.

title: Bio-Effective Cream- 57ml
description: Bio-Effective Cream is an extra nourishing moisturising cream that is an active revitalising and regenerative skin treatment for mature and dry skin care concerns. The Bio-Effective cream has unique qualities that are based on the exclusive properties of exceptional botanical extracts, a complex of Vitamins (A, C, D & E) and extra high content of selected nourishing oils.

title: Argan Oil 100% Pure- 50ml
description: Argan Oil is an organic nourishing elixir obtained from the kernels of the Argan Tree (Argania Spinosa) endemic to Morocco. The DermaFix Argan Oil is a moisturiser with 100% Pure EcoCert and Natrue organic certified Oil. Argan oil is a highly valuable skin care ingredient with regenerating and protecting properties. When used as an application for the skin, Argan Oil protects against moisture loss and oxidative damage, is an excellent emollient, easily absorbed by the skin providing a smooth skin feel and tones the cutaneous surface. It also reduces inflammation and provides free radical protection. When used in the hair, Argan Oil is a fragrance free, natural shine enhancer that has regenerative properties that stimulates hair growth from the hair root.

title: Revitalising Toner- 150ml
description: Optimal for all skin types, the DermaFix Revitalising Toner is an alcohol-free and fragrance-free toner that helps to balance, refresh and restore the skin’s protective pH mantle. Using toners and conditioners prepares the skin for moisturisation by completing the cleansing process. The Revitalising Toner aids in the absorption of active ingredients found in treatment products used after toning by removing residue from skin.

title: Brightening Toner- 150ml
description: This unique brightening toner formulation from DermaFix gently re-balances the skin and produces a brightening effect by inhibiting melanin synthesis. The brightening toner has natural herbal ingredients that, when applied, increase the skin’s resistance to stress, trauma and fatigue. Our brightening toner contains extracts of Pomegranate and Raspberry that boosts collagen production and refines the skin collagen production and refines the skin.

title: Hydra-Silk Cleanser- 200ml
description: The Hydra-Silk Cleanser from DermaFix is a light emollient skin care product. It removes make-up and other impurities without stripping the essential lipids on the skin. A potent blend of French Sea waters, Aloe Vera gel and Botanical extracts to promote skin health and hydration. The Hydra-Silk product is suitable for sensitised skin including rosacea.

title: Brightening Cleanser- 200ml
description: The DermaFix Brightening Cleanser is composed of actives, which inhibit melanin production reducing the appearance of pigmentation, age spots and helps inhibit the formation of new pigment while lightening the skin without being an irritant. Our Brightening Cleanser particularly useful to attenuate hyperpigmentation, glycation and other signs of premature skin ageing.

title: Active Cleansing Gel- 200ml
description: The DermaFix Active Cleansing Gel is a deep cleansing product that contains an oil-free formula that thoroughly removes excess oil, surface impurities and make-up. Active Cleansing Gel helps to exfoliate and remove dead skin cells due to Alpha and Beta Hydroxy Acids with natural enzymes to keep your skin looking fresh and healthy.

title: Gentle Cleansing Gel- 200ml
description: This gentle cleansing gel is formulated for normal to dry and sensitive skin types. Aloe vera and hops extract are noted for their healing and calming properties and is particularly good for skin that flares easily. It cleanses the face thoroughly whilst moisturising with natural botanical extracts.

title: Calming Microfoam Cleanser- 100ml
description: This hypoallergenic cleanser transforms into delicate micro-bubbles, lifting impurities from deep within the pores to gently purify the skin and remove excess oil. The skin is left feeling refreshed and calmed with a visibly more radiant complexion.

title: Sterex Apres Cosmetic Cream – 35ml
description: Ideal for moisturising & protecting your skin. Contains an antimicrobial agent to help prevent the growth of microbes post treatment.

title: Brow Code Imitations Micro Pencil
description: Fill in sparse brows effortlessly with the eyebrow pencil of your dreams - Brow Code’s Imitations Micro Pencil. Featuring a fine micro tip for precise application, this brow pencil allows you to draw small strokes on the eyebrow replicating your natural hair for a complete, put-together look. With its creamy texture and natural colour finish, the Imitations Pencil applies so smooth you won’t even notice your brows are filled in! The Imitations Micro Pencil also features a spoolie on one end to evenly distribute product through the brows and set the hairs in place. Available in six end-to-end shades: Light Ash Blonde, Taupe, Warm Medium Brown, Brunette, Deep Dark Brunette, and Granite.

title: Vani- T Sculpt & Define Brow Pencil
description: This innovative designed pencil glides on effortlessly to sculpt and define your brows with precision. Its vegan, waterproof formula provides over 10 hours of wear, ensuring your brows stay perfectly groomed without fading or smudging.

title: Brow Code Multi-Peptide Growth Serum
description: Achieve the look of full-volume brows and lashes with Brow Code’s Multi-Peptide Growth Serum. Highly concentrated formula, crafted with an exclusive triple peptide blend, Vitamin B5, Hyaluronic Acid, Pumpkin Seed Extract, and Biotin, improves overall health while supporting hair growth. Designed with a first-of-its-kind dual-tip custom applicator wand for effortless precision and convenience. Achieving fuller brows and lashes has never been easier. The Multi-Peptide Growth Serum is gentle enough for all skin types and should be used once daily for optimal results. When using as directed once daily, you can expect to see visible results in as little as 12 weeks.

title: Brow Code Gold Nourishing Growth Oil
description: The Brow Gold Nourishing Growth Oil features an exclusive formula of 5 unique oils, packed with moisture and nourishment. The oil is all-natural and gentle on the skin, promoting healthy growth of the brow hairs. Just one drop of Brow Gold Oil will make your brows shine and glisten and even better, it can be used after EVERY kind of treatment! It's a must-have brow aftercare product.
